# @vllnt/convex-progression

> XP, levels, and streak windows as a Convex component

`@vllnt/convex-progression` is a Convex component. Install `@vllnt/convex-progression`. It targets `convex@^1.45.0`.
It stores one sandboxed table — `progress` (one row per `(scope, subjectRef, key)`: `xp`, `level`,
`streak`, `maxStreak`, `lastPeriodKey`). `accrue` adds XP; `level` is the count of host-supplied
`thresholds` that XP has reached. `recordActivity` takes a host `periodKey` and optional
`expectedPrevious` (same period leaves the streak unchanged but refreshes level/timestamp; match continues the streak; a gap resets to 1).
`get` can recompute `level` when the host passes `thresholds`. `eraseSubject` deletes in bounded
batches without a write fence or completion token. XP is bounded by MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
reads validate thresholds too. Award requests are not event-idempotent; hosts must deduplicate
awards, reject late periods, and fence writes during erase. The host owns auth, `subjectRef`, `key`, `delta`, and `thresholds` (never take those from
the end-user). Distinct from `@vllnt/convex-wallet` (balances) and `@vllnt/convex-quota` (resetting
caps).

The only client option is `defaultScope` (default `"global"`). Result state is
`{ xp, level, streak, maxStreak, updatedAt, lastPeriodKey? }`; accrue adds
`{ leveledUp, previousLevel }`, activity adds `{ streakDelta }`, and get returns
state or null. Erase batches default to 200 and clamp to 500. Multiple named
mounts isolate state and scheduled work. `@vllnt/convex-progression/test` exports
`register(t, name = "progression")` to mount the component in `convex-test`.
There is no React entry or built-in leaderboard/calendar policy.
